title: Why You Need to Use Multiple Job Boards In Your Job Search
description:
One of the most common job search struggles I see is finding jobs people are excited about. The follow on to that is they tend to only use 1 job board. The truth is you HAVE to use multiple job boards to really find great jobs. Each has its own job inventory and search algorithm. Here is a short video searching 4 job boards for the same job with very different results.  

I’m also including a link to a list of over 100 job boards. Let me know if we missed any!  https://www.tealhq.com/post/how-to-navigate-job-boards-effectively
